articles.summary: Claude Desktop is no longer a chat app. It hosts chat, Cowork, and a launch surface for Claude Code, with MCP support, file access, and agentic execution on every knowledge worker's machine. Here is the governance playbook for security teams running it at scale.
articles.title: The Claude Desktop App Governance Playbook

articles.summary: GitHub shipped postToolUse hooks in the Copilot CLI on May 18, 2026. Unbound now governs Copilot at parity with Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor: audit, warn, approve, block on the most widely deployed AI coding agent in the enterprise.
articles.title: Unbound Brings Full Enforcement to GitHub Copilot
